title: Victron Charge Cycle Efficiency Trend
dataSources: Battery telemetry (`marine:battery`), AIS traffic (`marine:ais`), shore power (`marina:power`), tide forecasts (`tide:table`), export syncs (`marine:export`).
app: Boating and marine telemetry — Victron BMV battery exports, AIS transponder logs, shore-power meter readings, and NOAA tide tables — streamed to Splunk HEC via NMEA exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marine:battery charge_source=* charge_efficiency_pct=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(charge_efficiency_pct) as metric by _time charge_source
| sort 0 _time charge_source
description: Trends monthly charge efficiency percentage by charge source for battery maintenance.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether battery maintenance are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `charge_source` on `marine:battery` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly charge efficiency percentage.
visualization: Line chart of monthly charge efficiency percentage by charge source.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how charge efficiency percentage changes month by month for each charge source so you can see whether battery maintenance are heading the right way.
